tatties.Season 1.5kg lamb shoulder and brown all over in a heavy pot.Add 2 chopped onions, 3 chunky carrots, 75g pearl barley, 2 rosemary sprigs and 750ml chicken stock.Cover and braise at 160°C for 3 the cake.Glaze with warm honey and set a single raspberry on top.Triplets' stolen raspberry jam tartsMerida's little brothers pinching the tartsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Shortcrust rounds pressed into a patty tin, filled with raspberry jam, baked at 190°C for 15 minutes and dusted with icing sugar.Roll 2 sheets shortcrust pastry to 3mm and cut 12 rounds with an 8cm cutter.Press into a greased patty tin and prick the bases.Spoon 1 heaped teaspoon of raspberry jam into each, no more or it will bubble over.Bake at 190°C for 15 minutes until the pastry is golden.Cool in the tin for 10 cream.Pour into tall glasses and top with whipped cream and the rest of the oats.
